description: Sequencer up to 96 steps long that spreads a chosen number of hits as evenly as it can across the pattern, with voltage control over length, hits and rotation

params.text: Sets how many steps the pattern runs for, from 1 to 96
Sets how many of the steps are hits, as a percentage of the pattern length
Rotates the pattern, as a percentage of the pattern length, when SHIFT SOURCE is set to CV
Attenuverts the length CV before it is added to the LENGTH knob's step count
Attenuverts the hits CV before it is added to the HITS knob setting
Attenuverts the shift CV before it is added to the SHIFT knob setting
Rotates the pattern one step to the left each time it is pressed, when SHIFT SOURCE is set to STEP
Rotates the pattern one step to the right each time it is pressed, when SHIFT SOURCE is set to STEP
Chooses what rotates the pattern: the SHIFT knob and its CV, the step buttons, or an automatic shift left or right at the end of every cycle

inputs.text: The pattern advances while the voltage here is high; with nothing patched the pattern runs
Advances the pattern by one step on each rising edge
A trigger here returns the pattern to its first step
Voltage control over the pattern length, attenuverted and added to the LENGTH knob
Voltage control over the number of hits, attenuverted and added to the HITS knob
Voltage control over the rotation, attenuverted and added to the SHIFT knob
A trigger here rotates the pattern one step to the left
A trigger here rotates the pattern one step to the right

outputs.text: A trigger on every step that is a hit, following the pulse width of the clock
Goes high for the whole of any step that is a hit
A trigger on every step that is not a hit, following the pulse width of the clock
Goes high for the whole of any step that is not a hit
A trigger each time the last step of the pattern has finished

menu: Quantize — holds a change at the length, hits and shift CV inputs until the next clock edge
Initialize Pattern — puts the LENGTH, HITS and SHIFT knobs back to their default positions
Randomize Pattern — sets the LENGTH, HITS and SHIFT knobs at random
Add CV expander — places a Euclidean Sequencer Expander to the right of this module
